$comment: The skill shape canon asks for, as data (zheref/hatsu#502; SDD plan, SDD on Hatsu's own prose, wave 4; assessment finding B6): every claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md carries a level-2 heading naming its Residue, its Authority and its Hard limits, in any order and in any heading that names them (`## 6. Authority and hard limits` satisfies two). scripts/skill_shape_check.mts reads this file and hands each touched skill to `nen pr body-check --body-from <SKILL.md> --requirements-from <the requirements below, less the skill's exemptions>`, so the heading match is nen's and no shell restates it. Enforced AS TOUCHED: a skill no change set touches is never failed for it, so the skills that predate this file are fixed when an effort next edits them. The posture is docs/config/skill-shape.json.md's.
$exemptions: One entry per skill that may lack a section: {"skill": "<claude/skills directory name>", "sections": ["<a requirement name above>", ...], "reason": "<why this skill has no such section>"}. An entry with no reason, an empty reason, an unknown skill or section, or a section the skill in fact carries when it is checked, fails the check by name. An empty list is a decision: no skill is exempt.
